blocks.text: Python ek mashhoor, har fan mola, high-level programming language hai jo apni saadgi aur parhne mein aasani ke liye mashhoor hai, is liye naye seekhne walon aur mahireen dono ke liye behtareen hai. Yeh web development, data analysis, artificial intelligence aur bohat kuch mein istemal hoti hai. Is ka seedha syntax aur wazeh banawat naye seekhne walon ko pecheeda qawaid ki bajaye programming ke khayalat par tawajjo dene deti hai, chahe woh chhota script likhein ya bara software.

Yeh chapter bunyadi baaton se shuru hota hai, jin mein development environment tayyar karna aur programming ke bunyadi tasawwurat shamil hain, aur modular programming, file handling, debugging aur data structures tak jata hai, ta ke aakhir tak aap apne programs aur Command Line Interface (CLI) applications likh, test aur debug kar sakein. Python ka naam British mazahiya series 'Monty Python's Flying Circus' par rakha gaya, saanp par nahi (Did You Know).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: code likhne se compile ya interpret, execute aur output tak chaar dabbe, variables, naming rules aur comments ke notes ke saath. Oopar daen: int, float, str aur bool ki misalon wali table aur input badalne ke notes. Neeche baen: arithmetic, comparison, assignment aur logical operators misalon ke saath. Neeche daen: parentheses se addition aur subtraction tak operator precedence, hal shuda expressions ke saath.
blocks.caption: Programming ke qadam, variables aur data types, operators aur precedence (topics 2.1 se 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Program code ki shakal mein likha jata, compiler ya interpreter se badla jata, chalaya jata aur output deta hai. Variable memory mein naam wali jagah hai jis ki qeemat badal sakti hai; us ka naam harf ya underscore se shuru hota, chhote bare harf mein farq karta aur keyword nahi ho sakta. Python ki bunyadi qismein int poore adad ke liye, float aasharia ke liye, str text ke liye aur bool True ya False ke liye hain; input() hamesha text deta hai, to adad int() ya float() se badle jate hain. Operators hisab, muwazna, qeemat dena aur sharait milana karte hain, aur precedence tarteeb tay karti hai: pehle qausain, phir powers, phir zarb aur taqseem, phir jama aur tafreeq.

blocks.prompt: Teen shobe bataiye jahan Python istemal hoti hai aur ek wajah ke yeh naye seekhne walon ke liye kyun munasib hai.
blocks.explanation: Web development, data analysis aur artificial intelligence; is ka saada, parhne mein aasan syntax naye seekhne walon ko pecheeda qawaid ki bajaye programming ke khayalat par tawajjo dene deta hai.

items: Python: mashhoor high-level language, saada aur parhne mein aasan; web development, data analysis, AI mein istemal; Monty Python ke naam par.
Chapter bunyadi baaton se modules, OOP, files, testing aur CLI applications tak jata hai.
